signin.title: Sign in
signin.devNotice: Development sign-in. Choose a seeded test account by email. This page does not exist in production.
signin.ssoPending: Single sign-on is configured by your administrator.
signin.failed: Sign-in was refused. Check the email and try again.
signin.unavailable: This workspace is not available right now.
signin.testNotice: Staging only. Skip single sign-on and sign in as the test administrator. This option never exists in production.
signin.testFailed: Test sign-in was refused. The staging test account is not set up.

admin.title: Administration
admin.overview: Choose a section to manage your workspace.
admin.sectionPending: This section is available through the API in R0. Its screens arrive with the next slice.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

no_access.title: You do not have access
no_access.body: You signed in, but this workspace has no active account for you. Ask your administrator for access.

tenant_suspended.title: This workspace is not available
tenant_suspended.body: This workspace is suspended. Contact your administrator.

idp_unavailable.title: Sign-in service is not responding
idp_unavailable.body: Your organization's sign-in service could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.

not_configured.title: Single sign-on is not set up
not_configured.body: Your administrator has not set up single sign-on for this workspace yet.

failed.title: Sign-in did not complete
failed.body: The sign-in could not be verified. Start again from the sign-in page.

placement.unavailable: This part of the page is not available
placement.failed: This part of the page could not be shown

brand.title: Brand
brand.intro: Set the colors, type, spacing and images your workspace uses. Changes publish when you save, and the checks below run as you type.
brand.name: Brand name
brand.strict: Treat accent contrast warnings as blocking
brand.blocked: Not saved: fix the blocking contrast checks first.
brand.invalid: Not saved: some values are not valid.
brand.saveFailed: Not saved. Try again in a moment.

contrast.title: Contrast and size checks
contrast.empty: Every pair passes the contrast and size checks.

assets.title: Brand images
assets.rules: PNG, JPEG or SVG up to 1 MB. SVG files with scripts or external content are refused.
assets.failed: The image could not be uploaded.
